# Ramp MCP overview

## Overview

Ramp MCP connects Ramp to AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. From those tools, you can review spend, look up bills and vendors, and handle approvals and expenses. A connected tool can only see and do what your Ramp role allows, and Ramp attributes its actions to you.

## Connect an AI tool

You need a Ramp account and access to the AI tool. Most Ramp roles can connect by default. If you can't, ask your Admin; see [Manage connected AI tools](https://support.ramp.com/managing-connected-ai-tools).

- **Claude:** Install Ramp from [Claude's MCP directory](https://claude.ai/directory/61bac03c-3f98-4b3c-affb-1b99533fa82c), then sign in to Ramp.
- **ChatGPT:** Install Ramp from the [ChatGPT app directory](https://chatgpt.com/apps/ramp/asdk_app_69250fb6281c819195b52a1556b0060c).
- **Coding agents** such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor: Connect with Ramp MCP or the Ramp CLI. See [Connect Ramp to an agent](https://agents.ramp.com/docs/guides/connecting).
- **Other AI tools:** Any tool that supports remote MCP servers with OAuth can connect to `https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp`. See For developers for custom clients.

When you sign in, choose **Full access** to let the tool make changes, or **Read-only** to let it view data only. Your Ramp permissions apply either way.

Connections expire after 30 days. To renew one, reconnect from your AI tool.

## What you can do with Ramp

Ask in plain language. Some examples:

| Area | Try asking |
|---|---|
| Spend analysis | "Show me our top software vendors by spend this quarter." |
| Bills | "Find our open bills from AWS and when they're due." |
| Approvals | "Summarize the bills and reimbursements waiting on my approval and flag anything unusual." |
| Expenses | "Find my draft lunch reimbursement from Tuesday and tell me what is missing." |
| Receipts and memos | "Which of my transactions from the last 14 days are missing receipts or memos?" |
| Receipt upload | "Upload the receipt for my Uber ride last Tuesday." |
| Policy and help | "Is my planned $300 client dinner within policy?" |
| Cards and funds | "Lock my card — I can't find it." |
| Procurement | "Submit a procurement request for 20 Figma seats." |
| Travel | "Show my upcoming flights and hotels for next month." |
| Ramp Banking | "Get all Ramp Banking account balances for today's cash snapshot." |

For every available tool, see the [Ramp agent tools reference](https://agents.ramp.com/docs/reference/agent-tools). Some tools aren't available to every business.

> **Important:** If you're an approver, the AI tool can approve or reject transactions, reimbursements, bills, and requests on your behalf. Approving a bill can send it to payment.

## For developers

- **Coding agents, the Ramp CLI, and custom MCP clients:** See the [Ramp agent docs](https://agents.ramp.com/docs/guides/connecting).
- **Custom clients and MCP gateways** such as Glean, MintMCP, or Microsoft Copilot Studio: Ramp must allowlist the redirect URI first. [Submit a redirect URI allowlist request](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/mcp-redirect-whitelist-request).
- **Custom integrations:** Use the [Ramp Developer API](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1).

For other questions, ask your AI tool to "submit feedback to Ramp," or see [How to contact Ramp's Support team](https://support.ramp.com/how-to-contact-ramps-support-team).
